jira.note: This pipeline never writes to Jira. Read tools only (getJiraIssue, search, fetch). Bug reports are markdown deliverables under qa-runs/<KEY>/07-bug-reports/; a human files them if they want them in Jira.
jira.setupNote: site, projectKeys and cloudId are tenant-specific and ship empty. Phase 0 fills them on the first run: cloudId and site come from the read-only getAccessibleAtlassianResources, projectKeys from the first key it is given. issueUrlTemplate substitutes {site} and {key}.

automation.configNote: playwright.config.ts is generic and shared by every run. It resolves testDir, outputDir and the raw-results path from QA_KEY, and baseURL from environments.urls[QA_ENV || environments.default]. Never edit it per ticket. Cross-browser coverage is opted into by tagging a spec @webkit / @firefox / @mobile.

environments.urlsNote: Fill the environment you test against. Empty means unconfigured: the Playwright config fails fast rather than running against a blank baseURL. Add or rename keys freely; environments.default and QA_ENV select one by name.

bugReport.issueTypeNote: Recorded for the human who files it manually. The agent never creates the issue.
